tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, and the acquired observations show a transition to negative response through H = 23.9. Fit all four dual-exponential parameters numerically and test the resulting law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed rows have s_grad equal to zero, so the sink parameter is unidentifiable; the simpler authorized dual-exponential mechanism accounts for the observed reversal.
The acquired slow-horizon rows already span the reversal and target horizon, providing leverage to fit the four-parameter mechanism.
The observed sustained long-horizon reversal and authorized adaptation mechanism favor the dual-exponential model over a periodic readout.
